episodes.title: Dino Park
episodes.summary: A dino park visit turns into a pulse-pounding, prehistoric nightmare starring Mater and Lightning.

episodes.title: Lights Out
episodes.summary: The rain-soaked duo check into a creepy hotel where Lightning is haunted by four-wheeled frights.

episodes.title: Salt Fever
episodes.summary: When Mater is outfitted as a racer, he experiences record speeds and an out-of-chassis experience.

episodes.title: The Legend
episodes.summary: Mater and Lightning join local creature hunters in their search for a mysterious, elusive "monster."

episodes.title: Show Time
episodes.summary: A traveling circus exposes Lightning's fear of clowns and his new friend Ivy's unexpected talents.

episodes.title: Trucks
episodes.summary: Mater bonds with fellow trucks at a rest stop, and they celebrate their solidarity through song.

episodes.title: B-Movie
episodes.summary: Lightning McQueen and Mater stumble onto a movie set and are cast in zombie sci-fi film.

episodes.title: Road Rumblers
episodes.summary: Road warriors carnap Lightning and Mater, forcing them to battle in the perilous Thundercone.

episodes.title: Gettin' Hitched
episodes.summary: At his sister's wedding, Mater must confront a past he thought he'd left in the rear view mirror.
